name: Connector plug half
summary: A plug-half representation identifies one side of a detachable connector.
description: A plug-half representation identifies one side of a detachable connector. Its mating reference and pin number preserve the circuit path when the other half appears elsewhere.
readingNotes: Locate the mating socket before treating the endpoint as an unconnected conductor.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A separately drawn plug is not a terminal block or an off-sheet wire arrow.
